verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA authenticator, so browser-extension autofill of TOTP codes and passkeys is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents mobile, desktop and web apps, cross-device sync, and code organization, but nothing about a browser extension or login-time autofill. The passkeys mention refers to passkey support for signing into the Ente account itself, not to storing or autofilling passkeys for other services, so it is not credited.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them
